reassessment_reason: The official help defines the address as principal address and describes the six- or seven-digit Business ID. These published semantics and the existing offline review contract were absent from the September 22 catalog projection; they do not establish physical sites, complete exports, source authenticity or acquisition rights.

candidate.publisher: Mississippi Secretary of State, Business Services & Regulation
candidate.product: Business Reports capped Excel export; existing offline operator-projection review
candidate.price: Public report is free; full-export terms and fees are unestablished

access.bulk: The public report exports a maximum of 300,000 results to Excel. The source directs users to contact Business Services for a full export; no complete export was acquired.
access.api: No documented public API or recurring unattended full-export contract was established.
access.automation: Interactive filtering/export availability is not evidence of permission for unattended acquisition or partitioned cap circumvention. No queries or exports were performed.

fields.summary: Published columns include Business Name, Business Id, Other Names, Profile Type, Domicile Type, Status, NAICS Code1/2/3, Address Line1, City, State Code, County, Postal Code and Formation Date. Official help describes a unique six- or seven-digit Business ID and principal address; identifier lifecycle and exhaustive status vocabulary remain unverified.

active_status_semantics: Official help gives good standing and dissolved as status examples. Registry standing is not proof of current business operation. The landing-page current-registered-business description must not be interpreted as an active-only extract because the help expressly supports dissolved records.
statewide_completeness: The landing page describes all current registered businesses, while interactive export is capped at 300,000 results and full export requires contact. A result below the ceiling does not prove completeness. The existing offline connector always preserves statewide_complete=false; no operator package or statewide source release was found.
address_zip: Official help identifies Address Line as principal address. That resolves the published administrative address role, not organization control or physical-site validity; addresses may be residential. The existing offline projection keeps ZIP5 and ZIP4 separate and never creates a physical site.
automation_terms_fees: Free interactive reports do not establish unattended delivery, recurring full exports or downstream-use rights. No account, payment, contact, agreement acceptance, scraping or export is authorized by this reassessment.
redistribution: No reviewed page grants retention, transformation, geocoding, derived-publication or redistribution rights. Existing offline policy keeps inputs and outputs local-review-only, excludes agent/officer/contact fields and recognizes potentially residential principal addresses.
temporal_refresh: No source snapshot timestamp, refresh cadence, full/delta/deletion/replay contract, manifest or checksum was established. A local workbook hash binds bytes but does not establish source authenticity, snapshot completeness or present operation.
offline_implementation: mississippi-business-report-offline validates a hash-bound original XLS/XLSX plus operator-derived JSONL and returns only an in-memory review projection. It does not parse the workbook, prove reproducible extraction or source authenticity, create a release, run a managed operation or change a pointer; all admission and production claims remain false.

citations.evidence: Official free reporting service, published columns, 300,000-row Excel ceiling and full-export contact requirement.
Official Business ID length and uniqueness description, principal-address role, three NAICS codes, good-standing/dissolved examples and formatted or standard spreadsheet exports.

strongest_next_action: Preserve the existing offline review contract and corrected published principal-address/ID semantics. If separately authorized, obtain full-export terms, snapshot controls, status vocabulary, supported delivery and downstream rights. This reassessment does not contact the source, export records, authorize an operation or enable national admission.
